meta.title: GitHub Resident + Skills Deck
meta.description: GitHub identity, multi-repository commit/push/PR and the repository registry; takes over the full gh CLI lifecycle (check/install/upgrade/modify, including a system-level gh — upgrading it goes through the system package manager and needs one explicit consent). Plus Skills Deck issue/map tools, 27 bundled skills and the sidebar panel. Disable the standalone Skills Deck bundle before upgrading.
